settings.name_in_paper: adversarial regime with a (Delta,C,T) self-bounding constraint
unmapped: Adversary constrained by (Delta,C,T) self-bounding constraint: Reg_T >= sum_t sum_i P(I_t=i) Delta_i - C at time T; includes stochastic, stochastically constrained adversarial, and stochastic bandits with adversarial corruptions (corruption 2C) as special cases
settings.definition_quote: In the latter the adversary selects losses, such that for some $\Delta \in [0,1]^K$ and $C\geq 0$ the \regret of any algorithm at time $T$ satisfies \overline{Reg}_T \geq  \lr{\sum_{t = 1}^{T} \sum_{i =1}^K \PP(I_t = i)  \Delta_i} - C.

algorithms.name: Any algorithm satisfying Reg_T <= B sum_t sum_{i != i*} sqrt(E[w_{t,i}]/t) + D

source.label: theorem:2
source.quote: The \regret of Tsallis-INF with $\eta_t = \frac{4}{\sqrt{t}}$ and reduced variance loss estimators defined in equation \eqref{eq:rv}, in any adversarial bandit problem satisfies \Reg \leq 2\sqrt{(K-1)T}+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{T}+14K\log(T) + \frac{3}{4}\sqrt{K} + 15.

results.notes: Learning rate does not depend on T, so anytime.

extra_assumptions: Delta has a unique zero entry i* (unique best arm)

source.label: eq:sto
source.quote: Furthermore, if there exists a vector $\Delta \in [0,1]^K$ with a unique zero entry $i^*$ ... and a constant $C\geq 0$, such that the pseudo-regret at time $T$ satisfies the $(\Delta, C, T)$ self-bounding constraint ..., then the \regret additionally satisfies: \overline{Reg}_T \leq \sum_{i\neq i*} \frac{1}{\Delta_i}\lr{\lr{\log \frac{T(K-1)}{\lr{\sum_{i\neq i^*} \frac{1}{\Delta_i}}^2}} + 6} + 28K \log(T) + \frac{3}{2}\sqrt{K} + 30 + C.

results.notes: Self-bounding constraint is at time T only; algorithm itself is anytime.

extra_assumptions: Delta has a unique zero entry i* (unique best arm)

source.label: theorem:3
source.quote: For any algorithm for an arbitrary problem domain with $K$ possible actions that satisfies \overline{Reg}_T  \leq B \sum_{t=1}^T \sum_{i \neq i^* } \sqrt{\frac{\EE[w_{t,i}]}{t}} + D, ... the \regret of the algorithm in any adversarial environment satisfies \Reg \leq 2B\sqrt{(K-1)T} + D.
